title: AAP Agent Identity Token claim set (AAP-SPEC section 3.2)
description: Claims of the AIT, an OIDC-ID-Token-analog JWT asserting agent identity. Issued by a Registry (Root Authority); `iss` is the issuing authority DID, `sub` the agent DID, `atx_reference` the sha256 of the current ATX the token references. Unknown members are optional-to-ignore (AAP broker profile section 8.3). This schema and the generated example pin the form for implementers; which implementations mint AITs is recorded where the implementation status note of AAP-SPEC section 3.2 says (the issuing Registry implementation's own repository). A `not` keyword beside the pattern of `atx_reference` and of `jti` rejects a line break: under Python's `re.search`, which the jsonschema package uses, `$` also matches before a final line break, so each pattern alone admits a well-formed value followed by one, which an ECMA-262 engine rejects.
